claim_boundary: Read-only source review plus independent CPU sampler/data-contract census. No claim of CUDA training success, causality, or elimination of all spikes.
launch_conditions: Run final repository tests and CUDA/source/resource qualification on the committed source.
Start a new run and fixed-mask bank under protocol v4; do not resume the stopped v3 checkpoint.
reviewed_boundaries: Guard calibration only reads the TablePlan training values; the original reserved split remains excluded.
The strict threshold uses linear quartiles, median, half-IQR and the same encoder epsilon floor; equality stays eligible.
Guard statistics stay in the sampler. Model input and codec preparation remain visible-only; protected cells remain visible and all-cell targets.
The global 2.5 percent budget, random discrete class protection and two-visible-cells minimum remain enforced without shrinking loss.
Protocol v4 and preregistration/source digests bind checkpoint continuation. Prepared cache fingerprints include actual masks, values, requests and code seeds.
Plan coverage counts unique protected training cells; evaluation coverage explicitly counts mask-cell exposures.
Post-clip norm is measured from actual clipped gradients before AdamW; W&B forwards pre/post norms under separate metric keys.
The ten report panels use current allowlisted metric keys; Query scores are explicitly conditional on eligibility.
